name: GivingCard - No Platform Connected
description: The page's one interactive control, in the state production is actually in: no donation platform configured, so the button resolves to a giving enquiry and the note underneath admits that no payment is taken here. A capture with a platform set would hide exactly that admission. The bar is drawn at 8 percent on purpose — a near-empty bar is what a campaign looks like the day it opens, and a comfortably-full one would misrepresent the state this page ships in. The frequency and amount chips are real buttons whose selection is written into the enquiry email; they began as inert spans and that was wrong, but the fix was giving the choice somewhere to go rather than making it pressable and still inert.
